Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, and Building Standards
July 17, 2024
City Council Meeting

ORDINANCE
WHEREAS, City of Chicago affordable housing data demonstrate that 26% of the housing units
in the Logan Square Community Area are affordable, compared to 36% of housing units
citywide; and,

WHEREAS, the property commonly known as 2625 North Talman Avenue is currently improved
with a church building, which comprises more than 9,000 square feet that may be adaptively
reused into multi-unit housing residences; and,

WHEREAS, the 2021 Affordable Requirements Ordinance and Connected Communities
Ordinance dictate that 2625 North Talman Avenue is in a Community Preservation Area, and
pursuant to 17-3-0307(2) a Neighborhood Mixed-Use District would prohibit single unit
tesidences and encourage the adaptive reuse of multi-unit housing at the existing church
building; now therefore

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Pursuant to Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-I in the area bounded by:

North Talman Avenue, starting at the intersection of North Talman Avenue and the alley
immediately north of and parallel to West Logan Boulevard and perpendicular to North
Taiman Avenue; a line approximately 125.86’ feet east thereof, to the alley immediately
east of and parallel to North Talman Avenue; a line approximately 75 feet north thereof;
a line approximately 125.86’ feet west thereof, returning to North Talman Avenue; and a
line approximately 75 feet south thereof, returning to the intersection of North Talman
Avenue and the alley immediately north of and parallel to West Logan Boulevard.

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall take full force and effect upon its passage and approval.

_ /
Lal! J I

Daniel La aint
Alderman, 1* Ward

Address Commonly Known As: 2625 North Talman Avenue


Zoning Application
Pursuant to 17-13-0303-A and 17-13-0303-C, this is a Type 1 Rezoning Application submitted

by City Council.

Subject Site

RS-3

RT

This is a general outline of the subject property, 2625 N Talman Ave, demonstrating North
Talman Avenue, West Logan Boulevard, and the alleys that run parallel to both streets. The site
boundary is formed by the property line along North Talman Avenue; the alley north of West
Logan Boulevard; the alley east of North Talman Avenue; and the northernmost property line
runs roughly 125.86 between North Talman Avenue and the parallel alley east of North Talman
Avenue.

Narrative

The purpose of this ordinance is to encourage adaptive reuse of the existing church building at
2625 N Taiman. This project will be further incented with a Low Affordability Area ordinance,
and will meet the policy goals of the 2021 Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) and
Equitable Transit Oriented Development. The project is expected to reasonably include 11
dwelling units, 2 of which will be income-limited affordable housing units per the ARO. The

existing parking of 0 spaces will be maintained, and the existing envelope of the building will be
maintained.

Bulk and Density Table
This is a description of the bulk and density allowed by the zoning district, and the actual

proposed adaptive reuse, which fits within the confines of a Residential Multi-Unit District. The
proposed zoning district will maintain the existing setbacks via a variation.

(1) Allowable Bulk and Density Framework for Adaptive Reuse of the Existing Church
Building
a. Maximum allowable floor area ratio of 28,319 square feet. Proposed: no more

than 10,600 square feet.
b. Maximum density of 23 dwelling units allowed. Proposed: no more than 11

dwelling units.
i. Rear portion of the lot, 7 dwelling units expected on roughly 6,400 square

foot envelope (roughly 3,200 square feet for each floor, across two floors)
ii. Front portion of the lot, no more than 4 dwelling units expected across
roughly 3,900 square feet total.
c. Existing off-street parking of 0 will be maintained via 17-10-0102-B1.
d. The existing setbacks of the current church building will be maintained with no
expansion or increase in intensity.
i, Side:

4. North building has two setbacks, of no more than 2.5 feet on the
northeast side of the lot, and no more than 9.75 feet on the
northwest side of the lot.

2. South building has two setbacks, of no more than 3.2 feet on the
southeast side of the lot, and no more than 27.6 feet on the
southwest side of the lot.

ii. Front: no more than 12.2 feet
iii, Rear: no more than 2.5 feet

Variation Sought: A variation is sought to bring the existing setbacks into
conformance with the Zoning Ordinance. No change to the existing setbacks is

proposed,

(2) Height: Maximum allowable height of 65 feet. Presumed existing building height: No
more than 47 feet
